statement: In pinned Linux sound/usb/mixer_quirks.c, the DualSense USB audio quirk identifies a UAC1 device and creates read-only Headphone Jack and Headset Mic Jack controls using terminal IDs 3 and 4. The sound-side input handler accepts hid-playstation jack events only from an input device sharing the same physical USB-device ancestry as the sound card. These controls are consumer-synthesized jack state, not evidence of physical PCM terminal type codes, volume/mute feature-unit semantics or automatic association of separate UHID and PipeWire nodes.

applicability.scope: Pinned Linux USB audio mixer implementation; no host execution, descriptor capture or physical output validation.
